newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 continues fall at week's close.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 continues fall at week's close.

text.p: The Prague bourse's two leading indices, the PX50 and RPIX, both rounded off a lacklustre week with further falls at Friday's close.
Major issues were almost all down but Komercni Banka, which has been one of the week's worst performers, managed an 11 crown rise to 2,371.
Dealers said Komercni had also moved higher on the over-the-counter market, to 2,385/2400, adding that the bank's recent poor performance was just a correction.
"I think it is quite reasonably priced now but long term, by which I mean the end of the year, it could go to 2,600 or 2,700," said Petr Koblic of Zivnostenska Banka.
The index's most heavily capitalised issue, SPT Telecom, drifted 13 crowns lower to 3,377, Ceska Sporitelna fell seven crowns to 345 and CEZ lost two to 1,043.
On the broader market, Vertex surprised no-one with another five percent, 246 point, fall to 4,689. Computer company PVT was not far behind with a 239 crown decline to 4,552.
Overall, activity was unimpressive but slightly higher than the average for the week. Turnover rose to 713 million crowns while volume was 754,472.
